description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the MyTimesheetItemAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time API module. It tests API endpoints related to timesheet items, including methods for retrieving, updating, and handling not implemented create/delete operations.

classes.name: MyTimesheetItemAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the MyTimesheetItemAPI endpoints, including methods for getAll, update, and verifying unimplemented methods like create, delete.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all timesheet items via the API, using data provider for multiple test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the getAll method from a YAML configuration.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create method of the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that validation rules for create are not implemented.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a timesheet item via the API, with multiple test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test case data for the update method from a YAML configuration.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete method of the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that validation rules for delete are not implemented.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Verifies that the getOne method is not implemented.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Verifies that validation rules for getOne are not implemented.
